cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native python3 -c "
import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/site'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from offline_discovery.rule_generate import build_clusters, _adjacency
import numpy as np
tests = [
  ([(1515,1515),(1516,1516)], (1,1), 'exact dist == eps'),
  ([(1515,1515),(1517,1517)], (1,1), 'dist > eps'),
  ([(1515,1515),(1516,1515)], (1,1), 'one equal coord'),
  ([(1000,2000),(1000,1000)], (100,1), 'cross penalty'),
  ([(1000,1000),(1000,1000)], (0,1), 'identical eps=0'),
  ([(1515,1515),(1600,1515)], (85,1), 'dist 85*? '),
]
for seqs, eps, label in tests:
    adj = _adjacency(np.asarray(seqs, dtype=np.int32), eps[0], eps[1])
    import math
    # brute force distance
    a,b = seqs
    S=sum((abs(x-y)+(1000 if (x<1514<y or y<1514<x) else 0))**2 for x,y in zip(a,b)); A=sum(1 for x,y in zip(a,b) if x==y); L=len(a)
    d = math.sqrt(S/L)*(3/5)**A
    print(f'{label}: adj={adj[0,1].item()} dist={d:.6f} eps={eps[0]/eps[1]}')
"
